_comment: HIMMEL-8088: listing entries a session sees that himmel does not own, frozen 2026-10-29 from a live session listing (Claude Code bundled skills and built-in agents, the anthropic-skills plugin), the qmd MCP server's tools/list (first sentence of each). An empty description is a name-only entry, as the live listing shows it. The climb never edits these.

skills.name: artifact-design
skills.description: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts. Load before writing any artifact, including a skill-instructed Markdown one.

skills.name: plugin-authoring
skills.description: Make a mod: a change to Claude's own interface or behaviour, such as a panel, status line, toast, slash command, or hook on tool calls.

skills.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
skills.description: Use when the prompt requires researching a topic across multiple sources and synthesizing it into a narrative report.

agents.name: general-purpose
agents.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks.

agents.name: Explore
agents.description: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches, when answering means sweeping many files and you only need the conclusion.

agents.name: Plan
agents.description: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans: step-by-step plans, critical files, architectural trade-offs.

agents.name: claude-code-guide
agents.description: Answers questions about Claude Code (the CLI tool), the Claude Agent SDK and the Claude API: features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings.

agents.name: statusline-setup
agents.description: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting.

mcp.name: mcp__qmd__query
mcp.description: Search the knowledge base using a query document - one or more typed sub-queries combined for best recall.

mcp.name: mcp__qmd__get
mcp.description: Retrieve the full content of a document by its file path or docid.

mcp.name: mcp__qmd__multi_get
mcp.description: Retrieve multiple documents by glob pattern, comma-separated list, or docids.

mcp.name: mcp__qmd__status
mcp.description: Show the status of the QMD index: collections, document counts, and health information.
